This is just a copy of the post from /r/gmod on Reddit, which I also wrote. Most of the pre-existing rules are copy-pasted verbatim, with only minimal changes.
 

1. Do not spam. If you have a lot of images or videos to post, put them in an Imgur album, YouTube playlist, or discusson post.

2. Do not post inconspicuous or one-word titles.

3. No excessive use of offensive or derogatory terms.

4. Do not beg for or offer to trade games or market items.

5. Do not post asking for or giving information on hacks, exploits, or pirating. This includes getting textures for games like Counter-Strike Source illegitimately. There are legal ways to get them without buying the game.

6. Do not post with the intention of starting a witch-hunt. This includes "Don't go to this server" or "Avoid this addon" posts. The only exception being if an addon is truly malicious.

7. Do not put tags such as '[HELP]' or '[Video]' in the title of your post.

8. Flair your post. If you fail to do so your post may be removed. If you're on a mobile phone that cannot flair posts, use the built-in web browser.

9. Do not post a video showcasing gameplay.

10. Do not post a link to your stream.

11. Server advertisements should be posted in /v/GMServers.

12. Please don't ask for server suggestions.

13. Please use Facepunch or CoderHire for job hiring.

14. Do not post solely to find friends to play with you.

15. If you post something in the form of a "meme" then the image and text must both be Garry's Mod related.

 
Violations are dealt with on a case-by-case basis. Each mod has their own freedom to punish as they see fit. There is no "statute of limitations" on rule violations, provided it happened after this list was posted. This list is subject to change at any time.
